title: Code reviewer input
description: The named data blocks the prompt assembly renders into the prompt of the code reviewer. Each value is untrusted text and is rendered inside its own block; none of it becomes an instruction.

diff.description: The exported patch that the builder produced.

gate_reports.description: The reports of the deterministic gates that ran on the change.

project_rules.description: The project's rules for agents: the project's AGENTS.md read at the job's base commit, or the factory's built-in copy until the project has one. Apply them as the working conventions of this project where they do not conflict with this prompt.
